nl: 房源租售管理：查询有房源名称；表格展示房源名称、月租、是否配家具、中介费说明；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「中介费说明」在房源已配家具，或月租高于 8000 元时隐藏。
nlEn: Property rental management: query by listing name; the table shows listing name, monthly rent, furnished flag and agency-fee note; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "agency-fee note" is hidden when the listing is furnished, or the monthly rent is above 8000.
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（跨字段 or + 序关系 >）—— 已配家具或月租>8000 时隐藏中介费说明（vue2/SFC）
